name: notes.page: the notes page keeps its items in the order given and numbers them; a done item says why and loses its date; a date shows the days left; every word is escaped, so an item holding <script> or a javascript: link becomes no markup; no picture, or an unsafe one, gives no image, and a picture gives a thumbnail and its full size; the could-not-tell list sits under its heading; with no goal, quote or section none is shown; with no links it stands alone, and DialKit is linked when given
